arabic text: ZAHRA KI BETIYON KI RIDAYEIN UTAR GAYI
english translation text: THE VEILS OF ZAHRA’S DAUGHTERS WERE SNATCHED AWAY

arabic text: ZAHRA KI BETIYON KI RIDAYEIN UTAR GAYI\nSAJJAD KO ZAEEF SADAYEIN YE KAR GAYI
english translation text: THE VEILS OF ZAHRA’S DAUGHTERS WERE SNATCHED AWAY,\nTHIS MADE IMAM SAJJAD (A.S) OLD BEFORE HIS AGE

arabic text: LAASHON KO RASSIYON MAY JAKAD KAR LIYE PHIRO\nSAYDANIYA TO GHAR SE NIKALTE HI MAR GAYI
english translation text: IT WAS AS IF LIFELESS BODIES WERE TIED IN CHAINS,\nTHE LADIES OF THE AHLULBAYT (A.S.) DIED OUT OF MORTIFICATION AS SOON AS THEY WERE TAKEN OUT OF THE TENTS

arabic text: JAATI THI JO KABHI KABHI ZAHRA KI QABR PAR\nJAANE KHUDA HUJOOM SE KAISE GUZAR GAYI
english translation text: BIBI ZAINAB (S.A) USED TO SELDOM VISIT THE GRAVE OF HER MOTHER,\nGOD ALONE KNOWS HOW SHE PASSED THROUGH THE CROWDS OF PEOPLE IN THAT STATE

arabic text: ZULMO SITAM KI TEZ HAWAYEIN THI JAB CHALI\nSAB GULSHANE BATOOL KI KALIYAN BIKHAR GAYI
english translation text: WHEN THE STRONG WINDS OF CRUELTY AND OPPRESSION BEGAN TO BLOW,\nTHE FLOWERS OF ZAHRA’S GARDEN WERE SCATTERED EVERYWHERE

arabic text: GODHON SE RAAHE SHAAM MAY GIR GIR KE MAR GAYE\nBACHON KE LAASHE DEKH KE MAAYEIN BHI MAR GAYI
english translation text: ALL ALONG THE WAY TO SHAM CHILDREN FELL FROM THE HORSES AND DIED,\nTHE MOTHERS DIED FROM SEEING THEIR CHILDREN FALLING TO THEIR DEATH

arabic text: RAMLA YE POOCHTI THI SAKINA SE QAID MAY\nZAKHMI HAI KAAN BAALIYAN BIBI KIDHAR GAYI
english translation text: RAMLA USED TO ASK SAKINA IN PRISON,\nO BIBI YOUR EARS ARE INJURED, WHERE HAVE YOUR EARRINGS GONE?

arabic text: BAZAAR LEKE JAO NA BE-PARDA ZAALIMO\nMAR JAYEGI HUSSAIN KI BEHNE AGAR GAYI
english translation text: O OPPRESSORS! DO NOT TAKE THE LADIES INTO THE BAZAAR WITHOUT THEIR VEILS,\nHUSSAIN’S SISTER WILL DIE OUT OF SHAME
